patient visit history

To view a patient's visit history, you need to click the 'History' button from the OP service billing screen. This action will bring up a form specifically designed for viewing the patient's visit history. ![Patient Visit History](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114621.png)

op billing service

The OP Billing Service is a comprehensive module designed for managing outpatient billing in hospitals. It serves as a centralized point for charging all outpatient services, ensuring that various billing activities are efficiently conducted through the Service Billing Advanced screen. Key functionalities include patient registration, insurance eligibility checks, and service selection. Overall, the OP Billing Service streamlines the billing process for outpatient services, enhancing efficiency and accuracy in hospital billing operations.
